notes.title: Pingbert's Snow Ride on the Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone!
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45350653/d08ec68b3c68fa878d257b4cc52119e9f2424328.png[/img]
[i]"[url=https://skfb.ly/ooHIr]Steam Deck console 3D model[/url]" by wallmasterr is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).[/i]


I am happy to announce that Pingbert's Snow Ride is currently being developed for [b]Steam Deck[/b]! 

Recently, I got a Steam Deck as a game dev kit and benchmark device for Pingbert's Snow Ride (and maybe also to play some games on the side..).

I was surprised at how well Pingbert ran on the device out of the box! This is thanks to Godot's (open-source game engine that Pingbert Snow Ride is being developed on) native Linux export, which allows for high performance SteamOS compatibility! Proton compatibility layer not needed! 

For the game's release, there is fine-tuning for the Linux build planned to make sure it runs as smoothly as possible on the Deck so you can take your penguin mail carrier adventures on the go!


If you’re a Steam Deck owner, I’d love to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Signup for Playtesting
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

First of all, I wanted to thank everyone that has supported Pingbert's Snow Ride so far! Either by wishlisting or by sharing the project through social media! Very excited to start sharing updates through this medium in 2025!

To start with, I would like to announce that you can now signup for Steam Playtest for Pingbert's Snow Ride! Selected users's feedback will be valuable for the game and will be credited in-game. 

While there is no date set in stone for the first playtest round, I am hoping to get it ready early next year! Hoping to you have your support when the time comes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45350653/0d78557af47683b4be5fb5dbd76b5458cd23521b.jpg[/img]


[i]- Bura[/i]
